name: Sketch Your Deepest Crush
source:
Your best friend is slipping away. A mysterious art club, quiet drawings, and painful silence.

Will you pull her back – or lose her forever?

[From [url=https://blacksteelcompany.itch.io/sketch-your-deepest-crush]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你最好的朋友正在溜走。一个神秘的艺术俱乐部，安静的绘画，还有痛苦的沉默。

你会把她拉回来——还是永远失去她？

[来自[url=https://blacksteelcompany.itch.io/sketch-your-deepest-crush]Itch.io[/url]]
